sections.label: Section 8-603 - Individuals Licensed on June 30, 1981
sections.text: An individual who on June 30, 1981 is licensed as a nurse midwife by this State is governed by this title and any other provisions that concern additional acts in the practice of registered nursing that relate to the practice of nurse midwifery.
